_how: Each node is one stretch of talk. 'say' is a list of text boxes. Then 'choices' (a menu), 'ask' (a text box: see finds), 'next' (another node), or nothing (the talk ends). Markup: [red]..[/] [yellow] [blue] [gray] [gold] [shake] [wave], ^1-^9 pauses, \n new line. A line can be {"text": "..", "face": "smile", "speed": 60} to swap to art/marquez-smile.svg or type slower. Faces: smile, angry, point; each talks on its own using its -talk1/-talk2 art. A line wrapped in (parentheses) is narration: no nameplate, in italics. 'name' is the nameplate; a line or node can set its own "name". A choice can have "needs": "nodeId" (only shows once that node was heard; "!nodeId" means NOT heard yet) and "once": true (hides after it's been picked). 'returning' is where he starts for someone who has talked to him before. FINDS: a node with "ask": "nodeId" opens a text box after its lines. What the visitor types (any case, extra spaces ignored) is looked up in 'finds' ("WHAT THEY TYPE": "nodeId"); several codes can point at the same node. No match goes to 'findMiss'. An empty answer or Esc goes back to the 'ask' node. A node can have "repeat": "nodeId" (if they've already heard this node, he says that one instead) and "flag": "name" (sets a shared rp_flags flag, the same ones the frequency scanner and RFT use).
name: MARQUEZ

say: (A gentleman sits behind a desk in the dark.)

say.text: ...^4 Ah.^3 A visitor.

say: Not many find their way down here. Fewer still think to knock.
How did you get here, anyway? Well, no, you're here to ask me questions.

say.text: Sit, if you'd like.
Back again.^2 Good to see you're alive!

say: I wondered if you would be.
How can I help you?

say.text: Marquez.^3 Mr. Marquez.

say: Any other names attract too much noise.
I used to be a shopkeep before everything went to hell. Now I reside where nothing can find me.

say.text: One name at a time, friend.
You'll earn the other one.

say: [yellow]Sooner than you think, friend.[/]
We are in the back-backstage!^5
[gray]I think, anyway...[/]

say.text: Everything up there is on display.^9 Everything down here is [gold]abandoned[/].

say: Advice.^2 Hm.
Pick a thread and I'll tell you what I can.

say.text: Ah, yes, that thing!

say: That thing has so much to offer! I brought it here from my shop!

say.text: You can do anything you set your mind to with it!

say: Well, I haven't seen that thing in so long, I couldn't tell you with any sort of certainty what it does.
Unless...^3 [yellow]No, he didn't.[/]

say.text: The board! Yes! That's my doing!

say: [gray]I wish I could help you more.[/]
I don't remember anything on that board, I've been here for so long...

say.text: [shake]TODD.[/]
He [red]ruined[/]...
[red][shake]E V E R Y T H I N G ! ! ! ![/]

say: Don't listen to him. Ever! He lies!
[gray]Lies . . .[/]
Did you, now.

say.text: Go on, then.^2 Show me.
Try and find the door... It moves a lot!

say: (He settles back into the dark.)

say.text: Not yet, I think.^3 Come back when your hands are shaking.

say: You'll know soon enough, young one.
(He goes very still.)

say.text: ...^5 Where did you hear that?

say: No.^2 Don't tell me. Someone's been talking on that frequency again.

say.text: Cedar.^4 Yes.^3 That was me, once.
Keep it between us, would you? [yellow]Names carry, down here.[/]
Once was enough, friend.
[gray]Names carry.[/]
...^3 That's his voice. I'd know it anywhere.

say: Whatever he said, he wants something from you.

say.text: [red]Don't give it to him.[/]
The page that isn't there!^2 Ha!
Did it tell you to go somewhere?^2 Then go. It doesn't say that to just anyone.
